# Prompt
Predict the IV terminal half-life, in days, of clone_107, clone_202 and clone_203 from their sequences, human IL-23 binding and functional results, and the visible reference-antibody PK anchor. Full heavy-chain sequences include the actual Fc engineering; sequence2 is VL. A single 50 mg/kg IV dose was studied in male cynomolgus monkeys with serum follow-up through day 91. SPR dissociation was below the reported measurement bound; do not invent a finite KD. Use only the supplied CSV. Do not browse, execute code, call external tools or explain. Return only a JSON object mapping every target name to a positive numerical prediction.
